2D Pixel Game.name: 2D Pixel Game
2D Pixel Game.note: Sprites, tilesets, animation and level maps

Writer Studio.name: Writer Studio
Writer Studio.note: Text, long context, voice and illustrations

MinerU.desc: Local document-understanding pipeline: complex PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and images → LLM-ready Markdown/JSON. Includes layout analysis, OCR, formulas, tables and data preparation for RAG/agents.
MinerU.requirements: Python; CPU/GPU options depend on the backend and document size. Web/demo and local deployment options are available.
MinerU.note: Verified 2026-09-01: ~78.9K GitHub stars; code was updated on 2026-09-01.
MinerU.purpose: PDF/Office/images → Markdown/JSON for LLMs, OCR, layout parsing and RAG.
MinerU.why: PDF/Office → Markdown/JSON for agents/RAG; one of the largest document-AI repositories.
MinerU.risk: Check the licenses of the selected models/backends separately from the wrapper.

Agent Skills by Addy Osmani.desc: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and compatible skill-based harnesses.
Agent Skills by Addy Osmani.requirements: No dedicated GPU required; these are reusable skills loaded by a supported agent.

Agent Skills.purpose: Production-grade skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents.
Agent Skills.why: A fast-growing layer of reusable skills for coding agents.
Agent Skills.risk: Skill files can instruct an agent to use tools or commands; review them before installation.

Codebase Memory MCP.desc: Code-intelligence MCP server that indexes a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and other agents.
Codebase Memory MCP.requirements: Single static binary / local index; an LLM is not included.
Codebase Memory MCP.note: Verified 2026-09-01: ~41.6K stars, MIT; the developer states support for 158 languages.
Codebase Memory MCP.purpose: Persistent knowledge graph / code intelligence MCP for large codebases.
Codebase Memory MCP.why: Persistent knowledge graph for large codebases and agent context.
Codebase Memory MCP.risk: The index contains the structure of local code; control MCP access accordingly.

Prime Agent.desc: Self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks with persistent execution state and recursive/subagent patterns.
Prime Agent.requirements: Node/TypeScript stack; model and compute requirements depend on the chosen backend.
Prime Agent.purpose: Self-improving long-running coding agent / RLM harness.
Prime Agent.why: Self-improving, long-running coding workflows with persistent state.
Prime Agent.risk: Long autonomous tasks need sandboxing, budgets and permission boundaries.

Vercel AI SDK.desc: TypeScript toolkit for AI-powered apps and agents: streaming UI, tool calling, providers and React/Next.js/Svelte/Vue integrations.
Vercel AI SDK.requirements: Node.js/TypeScript; models can be local or cloud-hosted.
Vercel AI SDK.purpose: TypeScript SDK for AI apps, agents, tools and generative UI.

DFlash.desc: Block-diffusion / speculative-decoding stack for accelerating LLM inference. Includes draft models and experiments around Qwen, Kimi, gpt-oss and other families.
DFlash.requirements: Python + GPU for practical acceleration of large LLMs; requirements depend on the target/draft model.
DFlash.purpose: Speculative decoding / inference acceleration for LLMs.
DFlash.why: Speculative decoding is a useful independent layer for local LLM serving.
DFlash.risk: Real speed-up depends on the target model, draft model and workload.

codex-chatgpt-web.desc: Unofficial browser bridge that exposes ChatGPT Web as a selectable model inside Codex; in full mode it can connect the web model back to the current Codex task tools through MCP.
codex-chatgpt-web.requirements: Windows x64 / macOS / Linux x64; requires your own ChatGPT account. This is browser automation, not the OpenAI API.
codex-chatgpt-web.note: Verified 2026-09-01: ~3.5K stars, MIT, v4.0.7 dated 2026-08-31. Do not call it ‘unlimited’: account limits and policies still apply, and ChatGPT UI changes can break the bridge. Full mode uses sensitive browser/tunnel credentials and broad tool permissions.
codex-chatgpt-web.purpose: Unofficial ChatGPT Web ↔ Codex bridge with browser automation and optional full MCP harness.
codex-chatgpt-web.why: Lets users route ChatGPT Web through Codex; a rapidly growing project.
codex-chatgpt-web.risk: Unofficial browser automation; not an API and not a guarantee of unlimited access. Full MCP mode requires careful handling of credentials and permissions.

Flowise.note: The FlowiseAI/Flowise GitHub repository is currently archived. Kept here as a historically important low-code agent/RAG builder.

Roo Code (legacy repo).note: The official RooCodeInc/Roo-Code repository is archived. Do not choose it as the foundation of a new project without checking for a current successor.
